# Lens Browser and agent approvals

How Lens asks before acting, in the browser and on the desktop. About 3 minutes.

## 1. Approval cards

**Where:** Settings › AI & Command › Lens Command

When an AI proposes an action, Lens shows a card with what it will do, its risk, and Approve or Deny. Low-risk actions run straight away; anything that closes apps or changes settings asks first. Deleting, sending messages, spending money and credentials are always refused.

## 2. Claude and other AI apps

**Where:** Settings › AI & Command

Claude Desktop and Claude Code can drive Lens through its MCP connection. They get the same approval cards. Turn the connection off any time in AI & Command.

## 3. The browser side panel

The extension's side panel streams answers and shows a Local or Claude badge plus exactly what was sent. The standalone Lens Browser adds tabs and agent approvals in its own window when it ships.

---

In Lens, open the Guide (the **?** in the top bar, or type `/guide` in Lens Command) to take this as an interactive lesson that notices each step.
